what: The first photo panel, set with 120px side margins and 60px rounded corners, sticks to the top over 1.6s ease-in-out once scrolled just 50px (--fx-top → 0). Margins and corners go to 0 and it expands into a full-screen photo. Back at the top (50px or less) it returns to the rounded panel over the same duration. It is not tied to scroll and switches once at the moment the threshold is crossed

options.--fx-inset: Side margin of the round panel, default 120px — set to 0 when it should always fill the screen like on a phone
options.--fx-radius: Corner radius of the round plate, default 60px
options.--fx-top: Top position when round panel (top), default 0 — when the element is position:fixed, it sits below the large text (25.79vw)
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Photo panel with rounded corners (if none, the element itself is rounded)

use:
Photo
— When expanding and collapsing, fx:bleed(detail.on)

from.where: index.html .kg-key (first photo plate — fixed · top 25.79vw → 0 · sides 120px → 0 · corners 60px → 0, 50px threshold, off below 768px)
